ecfp.note: featurization + prediction with 5 replicate models, measured on the screen itself over the 100M test set. Weighted by shard size. CAVEAT: every box for this arm ran on c7i.4xlarge, the newest of the four types, while the other arms ran on an unrecorded blend that includes c6i and m6i. Its cost may therefore be flattered relative to theirs. The within-type shard spread here is 1.435, as large as the total spread recorded for most other arms, so the type effect is unlikely to dominate -- but it is not zero and is not measured.
